program.section_heading: Artificial Intelligence (AI) Proficiency for College and Career Certificate of Competency
outcomes: Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to effectively create and evaluate AI-generated content
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to apply AI tools to support learning and research and properly cite AI-based information sources.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to demonstrate the AI literacy necessary to excel in the emerging workforce.
